notes:
What’s new in DriveDeck 0.20.0

• Patch notes now appear in the update window before downloading and restarting. After an upgrade, a What’s new window shows the changes once.
• Use all twelve decks on a phone or tablet connected to the same Wi-Fi as your PC. Pair with a QR code or an eight-character code, with remembered pairing.
• Mobile map positions update more frequently, with smooth movement and cached roads, buildings and terrain.
• Fixed Model S and Model Three vehicle images in Drive on mobile. Fixed Ultra Sound’s song visualizer toggle.
• Mobile expanded view hides the dashboard toolbar when native browser fullscreen is unavailable.
• Settings → Display now includes resolution presets and custom window sizes that save for next time.

Upgrading from 0.18.1 also includes the phone dashboard preview and all subsequent mobile fixes. Your existing settings are preserved. Phone music controls and animated covers are not included in this preview.
